what a failing hex1 is doing: resetting the nibble at a comment
letting a non-token character emit or change state
running off the end inside a comment
emitting bytes for a label definition
decoding the name character after : as a hex digit
acting on : or a reference inside a comment
counting rel32 from the start of the field, or not resolving forward labels (want target 5 - (here 0 + 4) = 1)
getting the sign or base of a backward rel32 wrong (want 0 - (1 + 4) = -5)
mixing up labels, or not counting each reference as 4 output bytes on the first pass
letting comments or spaces change output offsets
